Hi Sanjay —

Welcome — glad to have NorthPoint moving through our procurement onboarding. To get you fully set up in our Coupa instance we need a handful of items so our vendor-operations team can provision an account and accept POs. I attached our standard vendor-onboarding-checklist but summary below: 

- Company legal name and registered address (inc. tax jurisdiction)
- Remit-to address and preferred invoice email
- W-9 (if US) or equivalent tax form
- Primary billing contact (name / email / phone)
- Bank details for ACH (optional; can submit later)
- Preferred PO acknowledgement flow (API / portal / email)

We also typically send a Coupa invite from vendor-portal@coupa.com — please watch for that and let us know if it lands in spam. If you run into any invite/SSO issues, reply with a screenshot and we’ll escalate to vendor-ops. 

Next steps I’ll do from my side: loop in Laura (vendor-ops) to provision if the invite fails, and Marcus will hold any early PO until we have a vendor ID.

Can you send the checklist items and W-9 by end of day Tuesday 5/11? If you prefer, we can accept a secure DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Procurement Partnerships
Redwood Inference
